translation:
In the condition of injury with vomiting of black blood, it begins from being struck and injured by a blow; the spoiled blood flows into the stomach duct (胃脘), and its color is black like bean juice, and it comes out through vomiting. In those whose form and qi are replete, use Lily Powder (百合散); in those whose form and qi are deficient, use Modified Chuanxiong Decoction (加味芎藭湯). <ins>Lily Powder (百合散)</ins>
Chuanxiong (川芎), red peony (赤芍藥), dang gui (當歸), lily (百合), raw rehmannia (生地), biota leaf (側柏葉), schizonepeta (荊芥), rhinoceros horn (犀角), moutan bark (丹皮), scutellaria (黃芩), coptis (黃連), gardenia (梔子), curcuma (鬱金), rhubarb (大黃, each one qian)
Decoct in water, add boy's urine and take together.
